Short-term tenure map (managed forest code 12) used in the the Forest Management in Canada, 2020 story map.

Short-term tenure map (managed forest code 12) with lands having shorter-term volume- or area-based tenure. The Short-term tenure map is used in the Story Map of Forest Management in Canada, 2020 (Aménagement des forêts au Canada, 2020) and includes the following tiled layer: Tile Layer of Short-Term Tenure Managed Forest Code 12: 2020
